---
title: Report the result, not the work that produced it
---

Lead with what is now true, leave out process narration, and never leave out a limit.

## What goes in

The outcome, the evidence behind each claim, and the decision the reader still
has to make.

## What stays out

Which files you opened, what you tried and abandoned, and the order in which you
understood things.

A limit buried under a summary of your effort has not been reported.
